summary: Frontend-only regression for Fork·Fate month takeovers + recap share card + haptics bridge. All 6 test areas from the review request PASS. Verified season drift overlay + toast for 7 new seasons (firstlight, clovers, petalstorm, flutter, kiteseason, skybloom, wishbones) plus regression on 'steins'. Confirmed /rituals seasons-list renders all 12 season-card-<id> testids with live badge switching per ff_season_test override. Confirmed /recap 'Share my recap' generates a 1080x1350 PNG via <a download> fallback (forkfate-recap-2026.png) and shows 'Recap card saved' toast. Zero console/page errors on /, /secrets, /journal, /recap, /rituals. TrophiesPill menu still contains home-menu-recap link (verified in source). Recap year/month toggle works.
critical_code_review_comments: AmbianceScene.jsx is 1774 lines — approaching maintainability limits. Consider splitting per-season drift renderers into a SeasonalDrift.jsx sub-module to keep the main scene <1000 lines.

Seasonal drift only renders when AmbianceScene mounts, which requires ambCfg (cyber/steam/tiki/fantasy/fairy themes). For non-ambience themes (dark/light/fall/winter/spring/summer) the takeover overlay will NOT appear. Since SEASONS declare 'All realms', consider hoisting the seasonal-drift block to RealmLayers or Home so every realm shows the takeover. Not blocking (works in the compatible realms tested) but a real functional gap vs. the season copy.
shareImage() fallback path in lib/shareCards.js swallows navigator.share errors other than AbortError silently — consider logging/surfacing so users know when native share failed.
seed_data_creation: In-browser localStorage only: ff_journal (10 entries), ff_season_test (each of 8 seasons), ff_intro_seen, ff_theme=cyber. No server-side seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reliably render the seasonal drift overlay you MUST set theme to one of {cyber, steam, tiki, fantasy, fairy} (or click a compatible tile in ThemeWelcomeDialog) BEFORE dispatching ff:season-drift, because AmbianceScene only mounts when AMBIANCE[theme] is defined. Parchment intro reappears if ff_intro_seen isn't set before navigation. ThemeWelcomeDialog opens on every load; dismiss with [data-testid=theme-welcome-option-<id>]. Recap share falls back to <a download> when navigator.canShare is missing (headless Chrome case) — expect_download works; PNG name pattern forkfate-recap-<year>.png. Test file for share: journal entries must have {id,name,cuisine,price,distance,theme,mode,dared,group,date,verdict}. Home trophies pill testid is 'header-trophies-pill' (not 'trophies-pill').
